messages:
Liam H: Morning team :wave: I started today in London. Quick questions: 1) pension auto-enrolment — am I auto-enrolled immediately or is there a waiting period? 2) holiday accrual — how is my pro‑rata calculated? 3) company expense card — any ETA for activation/top-up? CC @Sophie (People Ops) @Zoe (Payroll)
Sophie (People Ops): Welcome Liam! :tada: Congrats. Pension: UK hires are usually auto-enrolled after a short qualifying period (often 3 months) depending on earnings and payroll windows — payroll will confirm. Can you DM your NI number so we can speed things up? Holiday: pro‑rata is based on your start date, we'll pull the exact days from your offer doc. Card: ops usually ships activation within 48h, funds are typically loaded on first pay. Tagging @Zoe to confirm payroll timing.
Zoe (Payroll): hey Liam — payroll here. We run eligibility per payroll cycle. If your start date falls into this cycle you'll see pension contributions from the next pay run after enrolment. Opting out is allowed within 1 month of enrolment. Please upload NI + passport/visa to the HR portal: https://hr.redwood.com/uk/forms and we'll take it from there.
Jenna (Benefits): Holiday details: standard UK allowance is 25 days + bank holidays. Pro‑rata formula we use is (annual days / 365) * days employed in the holiday year, rounded to nearest half day. If you start today you should expect ~22 days (approx) — I'll confirm the exact pro‑rata in your benefits portal. If you want I can calculate the exact number for your start date.
Onboarding Bot: New employee Liam H added to payroll group UK-LDN. Docs to upload: `NI_number.pdf`, `passport.pdf`. Pension opt-out form: https://hr.redwood.com/uk/pension-optout. Payroll cutoffs: 24th 23:59 UTC for next pay run.
Liam H: Thanks all — my NI is AB123456C, I'll upload now. Quick Q re opt-out — if I opt out will that remove employer contributions retroactively? @Zoe
Zoe (Payroll): Employer contributions are forward-looking; we do not reclaim employer contributions already paid. If you opt out mid-cycle we will stop future employer contributions and adjust on the next pay run. You will receive a confirmation email once processed.
Sophie (People Ops): Also FYI — if you opt out now and later change your mind you can re-enrol at the annual re-enrolment or contact us to discuss earlier re-enrolment. For the expenses card: if you need an emergency top-up before payroll, reply here and Ops can push a small advance.
Liam H: Perfect, appreciate it :100: One last thing — public holidays for UK office: do we get Xmas Eve half-day automatic? @Jenna
Jenna (Benefits): Public holidays follow the bank holidays calendar. Christmas Eve isn't an automatic half-day unless the local team policy says so. We publish the UK holiday schedule in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.com/uk-holidays — I'll add a note about local team practices.
Liam H: Got it, thanks! Uploading now.
